preconditions.expression: root1 is not None and root2 is not None
preconditions.description: Both input trees must be non-null.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**9 for node in [root1, root2])
preconditions.description: All node values in both trees must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
Both trees must have the same number of nodes.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(levels_anagram(root1, root2) for _ in range(max_level(root1))) else 0
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if every level of the two trees is an anagram of each other, otherwise returns 0.
